title: Women Are Sacred 2027:
headline: An old gathering goes somewhere new: Women Are Sacred comes to California.
story: The hook is real news for their audience: Women Are Sacred is moving somewhere it has never been, to Temecula, California. A new place for an old gathering. Not tourism, not a resort ad.

Years of conference rooms, then the turn at 0:14: a wide exterior of somewhere new. That contrast is the whole piece. Miranda's words: the teasers do not all have to be conference footage, “even if it's just, like, we're going to California.”
do: Give the two-beat hook room. Do not rush the reveal.
Cut the archive montage with momentum.
Build 0:14 so the Pechanga shot swaps in, no re-edit.
Wait for Nick's OK before Pechanga goes in a delivered cut.
Leave the last 2 s clean for the lockup.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
No old WAS lockup (two women holding hands), even in the background.
No images of harm or fear. No red handprint. No statistics.
No generic California stock or random landscapes. Pechanga or archive only.
No Durham footage. This one is the WAS archive plus Pechanga.
